response.description: We are excited to announce the General Availability of Simple log alerts in Azure Monitor, available starting today. This feature is designed to provide a simplified and more intuitive experience for monitoring and alerting, enhancing your ability to detect and respond to problems in near real-time. Unlike Log Search Alerts that aggregate rows over a defined period, Simple Log Alerts evaluate each row individually.Key Benefits:Simplified Query Language.Low Latency Alerting.Support multiple log plans, including Analytics and Basic Logs.Pricing Information:The cost for Simple log alerts is based on 1-minute frequency Log alert.Learn more.
response.title: Generally Available: Simple log alerts in Azure Monitor
